subject.title: [Bug]: macos say command in daemon not output to speakers

question: Should OpenClaw support macOS daemon Local CLI TTS speaker playback as built-in behavior, or document it as an operator-owned wrapper/configuration pattern?
rationale: The current provider can run arbitrary commands, but a built-in `launchctl asuser` bridge would define macOS session, security, and daemon-support behavior that the existing LaunchAgent docs do not currently promise.

options.title: Document wrapper path
options.body: Use the existing Local CLI provider command/args surface and document a macOS wrapper that discovers the active GUI user/session without hard-coded UIDs.

options.title: Add plugin-owned helper
options.body: Implement a tts-local-cli macOS helper that handles GUI-session playback and file output, with live macOS daemon proof before merge.

options.title: Clarify unsupported path
options.body: Document that speaker playback from custom daemon/system-user contexts is unsupported and that Local CLI TTS only guarantees generated audio files.

recommendation.title: Document wrapper path
recommendation.body: Use the existing Local CLI provider command/args surface and document a macOS wrapper that discovers the active GUI user/session without hard-coded UIDs.

likelyOwner.reason: The Local CLI provider/docs and adjacent launchd history make this the best available routing candidate for the product-boundary decision.
